title: Let the right work find you.
description: Thoughtful updates. On your terms. Never just more noise.

start.title: Create your first job alert
start.text: Describe the work you want once, and new roles that match come to your inbox.

steps.title: Choose your keywords
steps.text: A job title, skills or a company. Every word must appear in the role.

steps.title: Pick where
steps.text: Narrow it to one city, or leave it open for the whole country.

steps.title: Choose how often
steps.text: Instant, a daily digest or a weekly digest. Pause or edit it any time.

planPaused.title: Your alerts are paused
planPaused.text: Job alerts are part of Plus. Your alerts are kept, and emails start again when you upgrade.

form.description: We email you new jobs in {{country}} that match every keyword.
form.name: Alert name
form.keywordsHint: Each word must appear in the job’s title, company, skills, city, work model, level or industry.
form.cityHint: Leave empty to match the whole country.
